interpretation: This is the first native sample at/after the20ns guard and also the largest absolute conduction current within that whole OFF window. The LED voltage has not become zero. The gate drive of XCLAMP is V(DISABLE)-V(LED_K), not3.3V, and positive source/body voltage can alter its effective threshold. VTH/channel current were not separately exported; body-effect/overdrive is a next-step mechanism check, not an isolated proven cause. Below0.1uA remains uncalibrated LED I-V extension. This is not measured leakage/optical extinction.
